title: On the feasibility of a quantum sensing protocol designed with electrically controlled spins in silicon quantum dots
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01109D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hoon Ryu, Kum Won Cho, Junghee Ryu
A type-II quantum sensing unit for magnetic field is studied at a device level with electrically defined quantum dots in silicon. A systematic analysis on control engineering and performance is presented to accelerate potential device designs.
